ModMetaData.name: Mobile Dragoon - CE Armor Resolver Fix
ModMetaData.author: Chengzong Liu
ModMetaData.description: Replaces Mobile Dragoon core armor resolution under Combat Extended with a CE-scale single-layer resolver while preserving Exosuit Framework structural integrity, module damage, shields, weak points, low-integrity pilot leakage, destruction, and wreckage behavior. Also changes the PV-4 core sharp armor from 45 to 57 mm RHA.
